# KIMS Nursery and Primary School (Kudos Indian Montessori Shikshalaya), Selaiyur, Chennai

> KIMS is a Montessori school in Selaiyur, Chennai, India, for children from Pre-KG to Class 5, recognized by the Tamil Nadu Government. It is an initiative of The VEDIC Educational and Charitable Trust. Children learn every idea with hands-on Montessori materials so they understand rather than memorise, and the school builds "The 10 Superpowers of Learning", the human abilities that AI finds hardest to copy.

Every page below is also published as plain Markdown at the same address plus `index.html.md` (for example https://www.kimsindia.com/faq/index.html.md). The whole site in one file: https://www.kimsindia.com/llms-full.txt

## Key facts
- Official name: KIMS Nursery and Primary School. Also known as Kudos Indian Montessori Shikshalaya, or KIMS Selaiyur.
- Recognition: Recognized by Tamil Nadu Government.
- Classes: Pre-KG, LKG and UKG (Montessori early years) and Classes 1 to 5 (Tamil Nadu State Board syllabus). Classes 6 to 12 are planned for children who come up through KIMS.
- Joining age: for Pre-KG, a child should have completed 3 years by 31 March of the year they join.
- School days and hours: Monday to Friday, and some Saturdays. Pre-KG 9:30 am to 12:30 pm; LKG and UKG 9:30 am to 2:30 pm; Classes 1 to 5 9:30 am to 3 pm.
- Method: Montessori, hands-on, concept-based learning; mixed-age early-years classrooms; English with Tamil and Hindi.
- Philosophy: The 10 Superpowers of Learning, created by Dr Sindu Sukumaran, D.Litt, Principal and Correspondent of KIMS and Founder & Chairman of The VEDIC Educational and Charitable Trust (founded 10 September 2015): The Explorer, The Detective, The Builder, The Maker, The Chameleon, The Teacher, The Superhero, The Time Traveler, The Shapeshifter, The Upgrader.
- Activities: Annual Day, Sports Day, festivals, family days, karate (trophies at the FCKA 2nd National Karate Championship) and the Science Olympiad Foundation's international Olympiads.
- Teaching children in Selaiyur since 2022.
- Address: KIMS, Avvai Nagar, Indira Nagar West Extension, Selaiyur, Chennai 600073, Tamil Nadu, India. Map: https://maps.app.goo.gl/pvtjJJ6JbX8Po89R7
- Phone and WhatsApp: +91 98842 61592 and +91 73973 94336 (both on WhatsApp). Email: thevedic@gmail.com
- Admissions: admissions for 2026-27 are open for Pre-KG to Class 5. Start with the admission enquiry form at https://www.kimsindia.com/admission-enquiry/ or book a school visit at https://www.kimsindia.com/book-a-visit/ . Parents are welcome to visit and watch a class at work.
- Nearby areas served: Selaiyur, Camp Road, Rajakilpakkam, Madambakkam, Sembakkam, Chitlapakkam, East Tambaram, Tambaram, Medavakkam.
